entities.name: Fani Palli-Petralia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Fani Palli-Petralia is a Greek lawyer, New Democracy politician and 
a former Minister for Employment and Social Protection. She is also a former Minister of Tourism, the first woman to hold this position.
